title: jsontoxmlsimple action
description: Converts a JSON body to XML as org.json does: members become elements, array items repeat the member's element, the member content becomes text.

addRoot.title: Add root
addRoot.description: Wrap the result in the element rootTag

rootTag.title: Root tag
rootTag.description: Name of the root element with addRoot

checkJsonKeys.title: Check JSON keys
checkJsonKeys.description: A key that is not an XML name fails the message; otherwise its invalid characters become _

changeArrayElements.title: Change array elements
changeArrayElements.description: Write an array as one element named after the key, holding an element arrayElementName per item

arrayElementName.title: Array element name
arrayElementName.description: Name of the element per array item, with changeArrayElements or for a top-level array
